name: get_alerts
description: Fetch weather-emergency data from the Weather Emergency Platform API for any location the user names. Pass the full API path with a query string. Endpoints: /api/nws-alerts, /api/amber-alerts, /api/noaa-radio, /api/911-public-calls, /api/cad, /api/power-outages, /api/gas-incidents, /api/hrrr-summary, /api/storm-reports. Location params: lat=&lon=, zip=, city=[&state=], county=[&state=], state=. Example: /api/nws-alerts?city=Eaton&state=OH

endpoint.description: API path with query string, starting with /api/. Example: /api/hrrr-summary?lat=39.75&lon=-84.65
